name: Jump Rope
instructions: Hold the rope handles at hip height with elbows close to your body.
Swing the rope using your wrists, not your arms.
Jump just high enough to clear the rope.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
longevityNotes: Cardiovascular fitness is the single strongest predictor of a long, active life. Regular cardio work keeps the heart, lungs, and brain in shape for decades.
overview: A skill-based cardio exercise using a rope to improve coordination and conditioning.

sources.title: Original to the LIFT knowledge base

attribution: Original prose written for the LIFT knowledge base (CC BY 4.0).
commonMistakes: Using the whole arm to turn the rope
safetyNotes: Use a firm surface; skip if you have Achilles or shin problems.
